lines: Decision needed from Brandon, unchanged, one thing only he can do: the automation that restarts this build ends Friday noon Mountain Time and a run may not move its own end. He can move the end to Sunday noon in the automation's settings, or write any line in the thread. The Partner raises it again Friday morning. Open item 252.

Chain 20 is read whole and on origin main (`35d00e1b`, pushed 07:00 UTC): fall's scene fifth list and fall's air fourth list. On it: tsc exit 0, build exit 0, "pass M3 fall-rest: 0.7971" (threshold 0.75), the change measure M4 0.9694, 0.9106, 0.9541, 0.9584 and M5 0.9929, 1, 0.963, 0.9997, all pass; 2 of the eight draft stills changed, fall's two, as they should; the whole vitest 67 files passed and 1 skipped, 930 tests passed and 4 skipped; `node tools/miniatures.mjs` pass; fall stands at 1,795,269 of 1,800,000 triangles. Picture 1 is fall at rest on it, the approved picture left and the build right. Below the bar: the air's depth and sparks, a twiggier tree, the base's vines, the ground and the fence.

Round 22 on summer is read whole and closed at 07:11 UTC: no pass. R1 4 of 10, R3 5 and 5, R4 8 where Round 21's read 3, the jury 8 of 15 against a bar of 0.6 where Round 21's read 3 of 15. The machine checks G1 to G16 pass, with D2, D3, D5 and D6 red as delivery items; the measures read 19 of 19 green, M3 0.7875 at final. What the seven jurors who answered (c) named most: the seeds as starbursts (4 of 7), a centred product shot (4 of 7), flat shells and sea glass (3 of 7). The film critic's three majors are in the change of season: the hand over of the outside reads as a flash cut at 23.10 to 23.53 s, the globe stays at one lift height in a uniform streak field at 22.23 to 23.10 s, the ground's accent comes as a strip at 24.07 to 24.37 s. Every list is with summer's builders and the change's finisher. By decision 132 this was summer's last round inside its limit of three, so Round 23 will be logged as past the limit, by decision 162; a limit is not a pass. Summer is below the bar.

Picture 3 is what the jury named first, summer's seeds: the approved picture left and the build right. My count on that crop: about 40 seeds in the approved where the build holds about 15, and the approved's are soft round tufts of about 24 to 34 px at hd where the build's are long rayed stars up to about 68 px. My measure of the open air in five boxes says the build's air is not lighter than the approved's, so the haze the critic names is the missing seeds and sparks and not a level. The seeds' list is with the air's builder, first pair 08:15 UTC.

Chain 21 is running since 07:01 UTC on two merges, not on origin yet: summer's take over of the change in smaller steps and spring's base fifth list. Read so far: tsc exit 0, spring's base made again, build exit 0, engine `d60873f4d4a91c7c`, "pass M3 spring-rest: 0.8566" with the base at 0.889, "pass M3 summer-rest: 0.8379", the change measure M4 0.9694, 0.8687, 0.9541, 0.9584 and M5 0.9934, 1, 0.963, 0.9997, all pass; 2 of the eight draft stills changed, spring's two, as they should; spring stands at 1,453,115 triangles. The whole vitest is still running. One cost of the take over, said plainly: shake 2's cover at the swap reads 0.8687 where chain 20's read 0.9106, which is 0.019 over its threshold of 0.85; the builder is told and its landing work has to bring the cover back.

Picture 4 is spring's base: the approved picture above, the third list in the middle, the fifth list below. The fifth list is lower and its outline lies nearer the approved's; the seat under the glass shows a brown ring where the approved's moss hugs the glass. Its builder's last proofs (STATED): determinism pass, the six stills of the other seasons unchanged, the landed still looked at. Below the bar.

Picture 2 is summer's miniature: the approved picture above, main in the middle, the fourth list below, pushed and not on main yet (it merges in chain 22). The cottage is stone and slate now and the lawn's crawl fell from 4.89 to 0.66 in 100 (STATED). The fifth list is ordered: pond, sunlit turf, the sand at the near rim, the fence. Below the bar.

Fall's base, the ninth push, came in at 07:14 UTC (`c291a11c`): M3 0.8047 at review with the base at 0.805, thin over my 0.80, and its builder says plainly that the number rides on paint at the left tangle and not on form, and that fall would stand at 1,799,613 of 1,800,000 triangles with it (both STATED). I look at its three pictures before I rule. Fall's air fifth list is pushed (leaves at the approved's size) and merges in chain 22 with fall's scene sixth list, due 07:25 UTC.

4K motion, the reading that was open (STATED by the shutter's builder, five frames at 3840): spring's lit moss holds and does not boil; neighbour frames differ in 4 to 11% of pixels over 12 levels beyond a clean slide, frames two apart in 2 to 4%; frame 2784 of shake 4 is clean. Winter, summer and fall are ordered the same way, report 08:15 UTC. 4K motion is still not a pass and no master is drawn before that.

The change of season: its finisher read shake 3 again on main with fall's new air (STATED, its own ruler): frame 2120 steps 5.5, under the bar of 6 now, and frame 2121 steps 9.5, over it. The cause it measured: fall's storm comes thin and dark, so the glass loses its cover faster than the law means. It mends that and has the film critic's majors; next word 08:00 UTC, push about 09:20 UTC. Preview 06 is drawn at chain 22's head on three helper machines, and a later one after that mend. The controls: nothing new; an early press still links programs in the middle of a shake, and 60 a second, sound, touch, Safari, Firefox on a real card and a screen reader are not seen.

Render counts since the last status. Drawn here: chain 20's and chain 21's measures and draft stills. On helper machines: Round 22's pack of 31 pictures and ten motion sheets, five frames at 3840 for fine motion, the builders' own stills. No frame of the masters yet.
Sound: 7,420 of 10,000 credits, unchanged, no call planned.
